kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
يرتئس (form VIII)
# يَرْتَئِسُ (yartaʔisu) /jar.ta.ʔi.su/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِرْتَأَسَ (irtaʔasa)
# يَرْتَئِسَ (yartaʔisa) /jar.ta.ʔi.sa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَأَسَ (irtaʔasa)
# يَرْتَئِسْ (yartaʔis) /jar.ta.ʔis/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِرْتَأَسَ (irtaʔasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
